WitnessONE · corrected architecture

One connection at a time — prep online, witness offline

The field laptop is never on the internet and on the asset at once (air-gapped field network, single NIC). So “online” is a phase, not a branch: pull the registry, disconnect, witness the asset offline, reconnect later to push what changed.

Agent / certificate (accent) live-verified store / issued draft / demo (never issues) carried across a phase rejected / out of scope

Exclusivity is enforced

PREP → FIELD → SYNC is a real state machine; the software refuses to hold internet and asset at the same time.

The Agent owns the wire

All Modbus I/O is in the Agent on localhost:5710. The UI never touches the device — the localhost hop is the trust boundary.

Live issues, SIM demonstrates

Only a live record produces a certificate. SIM stays as demo/dev/training, permanently labelled, structurally unable to issue.

Direct Modbus, no TOP Server

The hardened in-tool Modbus driver is primary; TOP Server + OPC UA is rejected (per-machine license, Windows-only, round-trip).
